mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 5.0% signals tight labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through earnings expansion.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 5.0%, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates multiplicative consumer demand strength, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS are rising (>0.5% MoM), SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.04 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL above 2.5% YoY) triggers Federal Reserve tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL is above 2.5% YoY, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production growth below 0.5% MoM for two consecutive months signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth < 0.5% MoM for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: When INDPRO growth is below 0.5% MoM for two consecutive months, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong real GDP growth (GDPC1 above 2.0% quarterly) indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 growth is above 2.0%, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS above 0.5% MoM) signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when PAYEMS growth is above 0.5% MoM, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 1.0% signals monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is above 1.0%, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
